goal: Add a workspace-level, post-DOX Cross-Wiki Discovery Layer that produces small, deterministic, agent-optimized artifacts for querying across many wikis, while keeping the same artifacts human-readable in Obsidian (phase doc §1).
lastAction: Phase 24 implemented 2026-08-10 per the phase doc §2 Components A-G + §2.8 pipeline integration: src/cross-wiki/ (workspace-scan, state, llm, entity-context-summarizer, entity-resolver, predicate-normalizer, relationship-graph, topic-clusterer, hypothesis-generator, run-control, index orchestrator), src/pages/cross-wiki/ (entity-registry-page, relationships-page, topic-cluster-page, cross-wiki-index-page), src/validation/cross-wiki-schema.ts, seven new prompts (the six listed in the phase doc plus cross-wiki-relevance-probe.prompt.txt for the §2.8 step-2 probe), the dox-writer workspace-pass cross-wiki exclusion + `## Cross-Wiki Discovery` section preservation/`updateWorkspaceCrossWikiSection`, schema-validator/link-checker extensions (the two new page types; checkCrossWikiLinks path-qualified resolution), the client.ts MID_TIER_CALL_TYPES mapping (cross-wiki-uncertain-review + cross-wiki-hypothesis → synthesis slot), the language.ts cross-wiki role directive, and the ingest wiring (crossWiki option default false, CLI --no-cross-wiki / TUI crossWiki: true, runCrossWikiPassFn test seam, IngestResult.crossWiki). Gates 24.1-24.15 encoded in tests/phase-24.test.ts (17 tests, all LLM-free via injected stubs + one callLLM spy on the real prompt path, $0) and green (17/17). Gate 24.14 full key-less suite run by this Implementer with .env stashed to .env.bak-phase24 and restored byte-identical (171 bytes, mtime 2026-07-20 00:13, no leftover): 493 passed + 14 skipped across 34 files (33 passed, 1 skipped) = the 456+14/29 Phase 23 baseline PLUS the 17 new tests PLUS four pre-existing untracked .state/upgrade/*.test.mts debug scripts vitest discovers in this environment (all green, not gate tests); zero unenumerated regressions; npx tsc --noEmit clean (run twice after ALL edits: one run showed a single transient failure that two subsequent full runs plus a standalone phase-16 re-run proved green — the documented phase-16 timing-flakiness under load, untouched code path). With-key profile unchanged: the 12 live Phase 2 gates fail ENOENT on the unmaterialized committed fixture and phase-11 11.13 times out (documented pre-existing environment condition, verified identical before/after — phase-02+phase-11 re-run key-less: 66 passed + 12 skipped). DESIGN DECISIONS A VERIFIER SHOULD KNOW: (a) Component C page descriptions are produced by the SAME batched cheap clustering call (the prompt returns title + neutral no-factual-claims description + mappedTopics per cluster) instead of one call per cluster — fewer calls, identical artifacts, recorded here per the phase doc §2.3 'Page generation' sentence; the single prompt file cross-wiki-topic-cluster.prompt.txt is the prompt behind cluster pages (gate 24.4 pins it). (b) The relevance probe prompt is a SEVENTH prompt file (cross-wiki-relevance-probe.prompt.txt) — the phase doc's new-prompts list names six and §2.8 step 2 describes the probe; a file (not an inline string) keeps every LLM prompt in prompts/ per the folder contract. (c) The cross-wiki pass is gated on the additive ingest option crossWiki (default false — the LLM-free library default; CLI/TUI pass true), the doxLlm precedent: this keeps every pre-existing key-less test LLM-free while production runs auto-run the pass per user decision #12. (d) Workspace-level cross-wiki state lives at <workspace>/.state/cross-wiki/ + <workspace>/.state/proposed-cross-wiki-matches.json (the phase doc's literal workspace-relative paths); in the default workspace that is the repo-root .state/ — the runtime artifacts are git-ignored (new .gitignore entries) and documented in .state/AGENTS.md so project memory and runtime state never mix in git. (e) Fuzzy candidate generation is deterministic (equal slugs, slug edit-distance ≤ 2 on ≥6-char slugs, or title-token containment across wikis); the LLM only judges identity — never generates candidates. (f) The `## Cross-Wiki Discovery` section is owned by the cross-wiki pass and preserved byte-for-byte by the workspace composer while wikis/cross-wiki/index.md exists (omitted otherwise) — a routine ingest never drops it, a skipped pass never re-adds it. (g) Relationship input parses the rendered `## Relationships` lines (both directions, deterministic template line shapes) and kebab-normalizes the readable predicates; Component F then canonicalizes. (h) cross-wiki state files are written by the components that own them; the orchestrator writes only the DOX contracts + fingerprint. (i) Empty-artifact safety nets: honest empty reports for entities.md/relationships.md/topics-index when nothing cross-wiki exists; the folder is created only by a running pass (≥2 wikis). DEVIATIONS: (a) above is the only phase-doc deviation (batched cluster descriptions). LLM cost $0.00.
